author: "Erica R. Bailey"
---

```{r }

# Load necessary packages 

library(dplyr)
library(report)
library(psych)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)

# Read in data

mydata = read.csv("AYFR_Study1b.csv")

```


```{r }

# Perceptions of authenticity 
mydata$percauth_3 = 8 - mydata$percauth_3r

mydata$perc = (mydata$percauth_1 + mydata$percauth_2 + mydata$percauth_3 + mydata$percauth_4 + mydata$percauth_5)/5

# Importance of authenticity 
mydata$import = (mydata$import_1 + mydata$import_2 + mydata$import_3 + mydata$import_4)/4

```

# Sample Descriptives 

```{r }

mydata$women <- 0
mydata$women[mydata$Gender == 2] = 1

table(mydata$women)

mean(mydata$Age,na.rm = T)
sd(mydata$Age,na.rm = T)

```


# Measure Descriptives

```{r }

mean(mydata$perc)
sd(mydata$perc)

perc = data.frame(mydata$percauth_1, mydata$percauth_2, mydata$percauth_3, mydata$percauth_4, mydata$percauth_5)
psych::alpha(perc)
remove(perc)

mean(mydata$import)
sd(mydata$import)

import = data.frame(mydata$import_1, mydata$import_2, mydata$import_3, mydata$import_4)
psych::alpha(import)
remove(import)

```

# Results 

```{r }

t.test(mydata$perc, mu = 4, alternative = "two.sided") %>% report()

t.test(mydata$import, mu = 50, alternative = "two.sided") %>% report()

```

# Figures

```{r }

p1 = ggplot(mydata, aes(x=perc)) +
  geom_histogram(color="black", fill="white", position="dodge") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(perc)),
            color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1) + 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 7)) +
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept=4),
            color="black", size=.5) +   
  labs(x="Ability to Perceive Authenticity", y = "")+ 
  theme_classic() + scale_fill_grey() 

p2 = ggplot(mydata, aes(x=import)) +
  geom_histogram(color="black", fill="white", position="dodge")+ 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept=mean(import)), linetype="dashed", size=1) + 
      geom_vline(aes(xintercept=50),
            color="black", size=.5) +   
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x="Importance of Authenticity", y = "") + 
  theme_classic() + scale_fill_grey() 


p1 + p2 

```
